title: KivoMotion — Performance Intelligence
description: Role-aware CMJ performance, coaching, model-validation, and data-quality dashboard.

metricDefinitions.label: Jump height
metricDefinitions.definition: Takeoff velocity squared divided by 2g, converted from metres to centimetres.

metricDefinitions.label: Relative net impulse
metricDefinitions.definition: Force-plate net impulse divided by body mass, in N·s/kg.

metricDefinitions.label: CMJ force signal
metricDefinitions.definition: Combined vertical force from the left and right force plates, low-pass filtered at 20 Hz and shown relative to the detected force takeoff.

metricDefinitions.label: IMU acceleration signal
metricDefinitions.definition: Low-pass filtered vector magnitude of the three-axis IMU acceleration signal, shown relative to the detected IMU takeoff.

metricDefinitions.label: Detection markers
metricDefinitions.definition: Movement onset, takeoff, freefall end, and landing markers retained by the CMJ/IMU event-detection pipeline for the selected matched jump.

evidenceFlow.title: Raw signal review
evidenceFlow.detail: Read the synchronized force-plate and IMU CSVs, applied the project 20 Hz preprocessing, and retained compact review windows around each detected jump.

evidenceFlow.title: SQLite transformation
evidenceFlow.detail: Joined jump IDs, derived role-ready summaries, and saved them in kivomotion.sqlite3.

metricDefinitions.label: Acceleration magnitude
metricDefinitions.definition: Vector magnitude of the filtered X-, Y-, and Z-axis IMU acceleration signal, expressed in g.

metricDefinitions.label: Peak acceleration
metricDefinitions.definition: Maximum filtered acceleration magnitude within the modeled jump window, expressed in g.

metricDefinitions.label: Acceleration variability
metricDefinitions.definition: Within-jump standard deviation of filtered acceleration magnitude, expressed in g.

metricDefinitions.label: Acceleration RMS
metricDefinitions.definition: Root mean square of filtered acceleration magnitude within the modeled jump window, expressed in g.

metricDefinitions.label: Acceleration area
metricDefinitions.definition: Area under the filtered acceleration-magnitude curve across the modeled jump window, expressed in g·s.

metricDefinitions.label: Athlete ID completeness
metricDefinitions.definition: Share of matched jump rows with a non-empty athlete ID that exists in the project athlete map.

metricDefinitions.label: Repeat coverage
metricDefinitions.definition: Share of athletes represented by at least two accepted sessions. Longitudinal change is available only for these athletes.

metricDefinitions.label: Event acceptance yield
metricDefinitions.definition: Accepted matched events divided by all force or IMU detections, with rejected counts and low-yield sessions reported separately.

metricDefinitions.label: Flight-time agreement
metricDefinitions.definition: Absolute difference between force-plate and IMU flight duration for each accepted matched event.
